The following is a list of changes made in patch v11.04.

<i>HELLOOO everyone! It’s JOY and it’s my first time joining the patch notes gang. 👋 This one is short and simple, but here’s a TLDR in case you still need it.

TLDR;

*Agents
**Agent abilities adjusted = Chamber, Sage
*Maps
**Abyss is BACK, Icebox is OUT
*Gameplay systems
**Ping audio made less harsh
*AOE ultimate indicator colors adjusted for clarity
*Gifting for the esports store is available</i>

==All Platforms==
===General Updates===
*[[Gifting]] for the esports store is live!
**Want your friends to rep your favorite VCT team? Head over to the esports tab in the in-game store to share your support.

*PHILIPPINES SERVER MENTIONED RAHHHHHHH 🦅🦅🦅
**A new server is opening up in Manila. This will be the sixth server available for selection in the Asia Pacific Shard, bringing better connectivity and game experience to our players.
===Agent Updates===
*We've updated Phoenix's voice lines and added interaction lines with Vyse. Enemies and allies beware!
*{{ai|Chamber}}
**{{abi text|Trademark}}
***Range restriction has been removed. We’re giving a little bit more strategic & positional flexibility for Chamber as his trap hasn’t felt like it warrants a range restriction in modern VALORANT. This went live accidentally in patch 11.02 and we didn’t want to revert a buff that was planned for 11.04 anyways.
*{{ai|Sage}}
**We’re leaning into Sage’s identity as a Controller-leaning Sentinel hybrid by allowing her to control space from further safety.
***{{ui|Buff}} {{abi text|Barrier Orb}}: Sage wall cast range has increased from 10m >>> 15m
***{{ui|Buff}} {{abi text|Resurrection}}: Sage resurrection range has increased from 6m >>> 12m
*{{ai|Sova}}
**{{ui|Adjustment}} Visual effects around {{abi text|Hunter's Fury}} have been adjusted to resolve more quickly and take up less gameplay space

===Gameplay Systems Update===
*Pings that are placed on the minimap have had their audio adjusted to be less harsh.
*AOE Ultimate indicator colors on the minimap have been updated to reflect if they were cast by an ally or enemy.
**All ally zones will now appear a consistent teal and enemy zones should now be consistently yellow. Ability icons will now only appear in the minimap zone if the ultimate is destructible.

===Map Updates===
*Map Pool Updates
**[[Abyss]] is back IN the [[Competitive]] and [[Deathmatch]] queues.
**[[Icebox]] is OUT of the [[Competitive]] and [[Deathmatch]] queues

===Bug Fixes===
*General
**Fixed an issue where a Concussed player's crosshair would stop swaying while debuffed if they quickly entered and exited a pilotable ability like Cypher cam or Sova drone.
*Agents
**{{ai|Chamber}}
***{{ui|Bugfix}} Fixed an issue where the minimap would still show the deactivation range of Chamber's {{abi text|Trademark}} while the ability was equipped.
**{{ai|KAY/O}}
***{{ui|Bugfix Nerf}} Fixed a bug where KAY/O’s {{abi text|ZERO/point}} revealed exact opponent locations with an audio cue. (This was fixed in 11.02 but we’re letting you know now 😀)
**{{ai|Astra}} & {{ai|Harbor}}:
***{{ui|Bugfix}} Fixed an issue where bullet tracers could be seen passing through Astra's {{abi text|Cosmic Divide}} and Harbor's {{abi text|Cove}}.
**{{ai|Phoenix}} & {{ai|Tejo}}
***{{ui|Bugfix}} Fixed a bug where the wrong voiceline played during round-start when Phoenix & Tejo are both present.
**{{ai|Neon}}
***{{ui|Bugfix Nerf}} Fixed a bug where Neon could skip her unequip delay by binding {{abi text|High Gear}} to multiple keys.
*Maps
**[[Split]]
***{{ui|Bugfix Buff}} Fixed an issue where molotov abilities did not properly spread up stairs after hitting the ground.

===Known Issues===
*There is a known issue where player resolution and display settings reset the first time people play after patching to UE5. We will not issue a fix, but make sure to adjust your resolution and display settings to your preferred settings after patching the game.

==PC Only==
===Bug Fixes===
*Competitive Updates
**{{ui|Bugfix}} Fixed an issue for end of game screens where characters were cut off in some languages.
*Premier Updates
**{{ui|Bugfix}} Fixed an issue on the Awards tab where characters were cut off in some languages.
